sources.location: https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2025/12/PXD053346/raw.zip; central directory byte range cached scratchpad/PXD053346/raw_tail.bin

claims.value: 12 Bruker .d vendor directories inside one raw.zip
claims.evidence: The deposited design names 12 raw file stems. The RAW ZIP central directory contains exactly those 12 .d roots under raw/; __MACOSX metadata entries are excluded.

claims.value: WT or INTS6 KO crossed with Control or DRB
claims.evidence: Design Grouping has WT_Control, WT_DRB, INTS6 KO_Control, INTS6 KO_DRB, each three times. Paper RNAPII interactome section describes the same two-by-two contrast.

claims.value: three biological preparations per condition, one run each
claims.evidence: The design has three consecutive rows per group. Paper Mass spectrometry section says IP samples were carried out in triplicate and prepared in parallel from cell seeding.

claims.location: characteristics[organism], characteristics[organism part], characteristics[cell line], characteristics[cellosaurus accession], characteristics[cellosaurus name], characteristics[disease], characteristics[sex]
claims.value: human HEK293 background from normal kidney, female-origin Flp-In-T-REx-293 (CVCL_U427)
claims.evidence: Paper experimental models and methods name HEK293 Flp-In T-REx cells, including INTS6 KO derivatives. Cellosaurus CVCL_U427 gives this line and its HEK293 parent, kidney-derived origin, and female donor sex; the paper Cell lines and culture conditions also names female origin. The generic ontology-backed cell-line value is HEK293; derivative identity is preserved in Cellosaurus columns. The cell-lines template requires normal for a non-disease-derived line.
PRIDE structured instrument is timsTOF Pro. Sample protocol and paper Mass spectrometry section describe PASEF acquisition.

claims.location: comment[cleavage agent details], comment[reduction reagent], comment[alkylation reagent]
claims.evidence: Both PRIDE sample protocol and paper Mass spectrometry section specify elution buffer with 20 ug/ml trypsin and 2 mM DTT, followed by chloroacetamide and overnight incubation yielding tryptic peptides.

limitations: The deposited design labels INTS6 KO but does not identify which of the two KO clones listed in the paper was used for these RAW runs; no clone identity is asserted.
The base cell line's female origin is documented, but an age in years cannot be established for these engineered cells; age remains not available.
The PRIDE reconciler flags trypsin despite the sample protocol and linked paper explicitly identifying it as the digest enzyme.
The PRIDE RAW entry is one ZIP; the SDRF names the 12 internal vendor .d roots rather than the ZIP container.
